name: IBY_BANK_ACCT_OWNER_CHNG_HIST
description: This table contains the history of external bank account ownership verification and other related updates or approvals

columns.name: ACCT_OWNER_CHANGE_HISTORY_ID
columns.description: Owner change history identifier for the external bank account.

columns.name: PREV_ACCT_OWNER_CHANGE_HIST_ID
columns.description: Last owner change request identifier.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_OWNER_ID
columns.description: Owner identifier for the external bank account.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_OWNER_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to party at HZ_PARTIES_ALL.PARTY_ID.

columns.name: OWNER_VERIF_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Bank account owner verification status. Values are from lookup ORA_IBY_OWNER_VERIF_STATUS.

columns.name: PROVIDER_VERIF_RESPONSE_CODE
columns.description: Bank account owner verification response code retuned by the validation service provider.

columns.name: PROVIDER_VERIF_RESPONSE_MSG
columns.description: Bank account owner verification response message retuned by the validation service provider.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Indicates if the change history record is in draft status or has been published into the main table.

columns.name: INTERNAL_OWNER_VERIF_RESP_CODE
columns.description: Internal translatable response code. Values are from lookup ORA_IBY_INTRNL_OWNER_VERIF_RES.

columns.name: PAYMENT_SYSTEM_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Payment system account identifier for the validation service provider.

columns.name: VERIFICATION_REQ_REFERENCE_ID
columns.description: Reference identifier for the request shared with the validation service provider.

columns.name: APPROVAL_STATUS
columns.description: Bank account owner approval status. Values are from lookup ORA_IBY_OWNER_APPROVAL_STATUS.

columns.name: PRIMARY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether this is the primary bank account owner.

columns.name: ORIGIN_APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Application used to create or update the bank account record.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATED_FROM
columns.description: Program or UI from which this row is created. Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Date of bank account activation.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Date of bank account deactivation.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: ACCT_OWNER_ENTITY_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the source of ACCOUNT_OWNER_ID. Values are from lookup ORA_IBY_ACCTOWNER_ENTITY_TYPE.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_VERIF_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Used to preserve the original bank account owner verification status code value when the status was manually overridden. Values are from lookup ORA_IBY_OWNER_VERIF_STATUS.

columns.name: VERIFICATION_REQUEST_TIMESTAMP
columns.description: Date and time when the bank account verification request to the service provider was initiated.

columns.name: VERIFICATION_RESP_TIMESTAMP
columns.description: Date and time when the bank account verification response from the service provider was received.

columns.name: EXT_BANK_ACCT_CHANGE_HIST_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to IBY_EXT_BANK_ACCT_CHANGE_HIST.
